notes: Only praise and a light roast on his lack of social media. Injury, religion, the Molina incident after the World Cup final and the Euro 2024 chant are all excluded. The 'six years for a business degree' claim is excluded because the club and Wikipedia disagree (4 vs 6 years). The 96 km figure is medium confidence (Wikipedia only).
